scripts.dev: export IS_PREACT=1 && bun clean:dev && bun bundle:dev && run-p build:css:dev dev:watcher
scripts.build: export IS_PREACT=1 && bun clean:build && mkdir dist/ && bun build:css && bun bundle && rspack -o dist/
scripts.bundle: cp -R src/static/* dist && rm dist/manifest.json && mv dist/manifest.production.json dist/manifest.json && mkdir dist/mathlive && cp -R node_modules/mathlive/fonts dist/mathlive && mkdir dist/pyodide && cp -R node_modules/pyodide dist/pyodide && rm -f dist/lib/pyright/python-typeshed.zip && bun run jszip-cli add -o dist/lib/pyright/python-typeshed.zip node_modules/pyright/dist/typeshed-fallback/*
scripts.bundle:dev: (ln -s src/static/ build || cmd /c "mklink /J .\build .\src\static") && (ln -s ../../node_modules/mathlive/fonts build/mathlive || cmd /c "mklink /J .\build\mathlive .\node_modules\mathlive\fonts") && cp -R node_modules/pyodide build/ && (ls build/lib/pyright/python-typeshed.zip || bun run jszip-cli add -o build/lib/pyright/python-typeshed.zip node_modules/pyright/dist/typeshed-fallback/* || true)
scripts.build:css: bun run src/css/cli.ts src/static/config/user.css && bun run src/css/cli.ts src/static/config/css/builtin/ace-shadow-root.css -o src/static/config/ace-shadow-root.build.css
scripts.build:css:dev: bun run src/css/cli.ts src/static/config/css/builtin/ace-shadow-root.css -o src/static/config/ace-shadow-root.build.css && bun run src/css/cli.ts src/static/config/user.css -w src/css/ src/static/config/user.css src/static/config/css/
scripts.clean:dev: (rm build || true) && (rm src/static/mathlive || true) && (rm -rf src/static/pyodide || true) && rm -rf src/static/mathlive && (rm -rf src/static/*.js src/static/*.map || true)
